newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen moving higher at open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen moving higher at open.

text.p: Wall Street shares were expected to open slightly higher on Tuesday, helped by some bargain hunting and activity in the technology sector.
"It looks like the market will probably open higher," Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "Yesterday's late selloff...didn't really add up to much."
The Standard & Poor's 500 futures index was up 1.05 points in early trade, at 919.40. The long bond was off 4/32 at a 6.59 percent yield.
Analysts said the markets would focus on Motorola Corp, due to report earnings after the market close.
